Landed: Gerrit 3429 merged as f163c9c987ffd17363bf4ae1cc85f37b29f24e68. The follow-up for the 7 test_uv_pin_guard cases (the tests expected a native-separator path while check_uv_pin prints POSIX) is Gerrit 3454, merged as 8c7a9d2ef7637b7719c5637c300ff2d8549fef00 (test-only).

Windows sweeps after both landed: job 135569438854 (run 44526811291) and job 135597358757 (run 44534782876). In both, no test from the deleted path-separators.args failed, and test_uv_pin_guard has no failures. The job conclusion is still `failure`, on tests owned elsewhere: halfcrazed-rubbly-whimbrel (MAX_PATH), scholastic-travelsick-salmon (earlier run only) and refractive-hasty-iguanodon. "Passed" is inferred from the absence of a failure under `pytest -q`. Not closing until a sweep concludes `success`, as the AC requires.
